Titles.jpn: アーケードゲーマーふぶき

Summaries.eng: Fubuki is a young girl with big ambitions, wanting to be the best at gaming no matter what the platform. Her best friend, Hanako Kokobunji support keeps practicing to be the best at gaming. Her inspiration to be the best was born in sadness, when her virtual pet passed away, the gaming legend Arashi, gave her a means to focus the universes gaming passion. When Fubuki is entered into the World Championship of gaming she has to battle the best of the regional tournament, before moving onto the national and World Championships.
Summaries.jpn: PP発動！全宇宙のゲームパワーがふぶきに宿る！

Titles.eng: Special Story: Paradise Beyond the Wall

Summaries.eng: It’s time for fun at the beach! Check out all the girls from Arcade Gamer Fubuki in their swimsuits.
Fubuki’s must battle to become the best in Japan, but who is Mr. Mystery and what is the Gulasic group. With the introduction of Fubuki’s enemies and what are their intensions?
Summaries.jpn:
4年に一度開催されるベスト・オブ・アーケードゲーマー選手権。
その東京地区予選決勝が、ここサンプラザ前特設会場で開催されようとしていた。
4万人の大観衆を前に、強敵・グラスジョーと相対するのは、フツーっぽい女子中学生・桜ヶ咲ふぶき。
彼女はその身に着けたPPが発動すると、無敵の最強ゲーマーへと変貌するのだ。
必殺技「一撃でクリアー！！」でグラスジョーを倒すふぶきだったが、勝利をおさめた彼女の前に、
突如出現した謎の人は言い放つ。「このままではキミに全国大会を勝ち続けることはできない！」と。
その言葉の真意は何なのか。そして、ふぶきを狙い暗躍する謎の組織・キュラシック団の目的は？
転校生・十文字ちづるの正体とは！？
謎が謎を呼び、全国大会の夜は訪れた！

Summaries.eng: With Fubuki’s lost the Chizuru disqualified, she must practice for the official rematch looming. Fubuki and Hanako travel to Hell’s river, they meet another wacky character, but who is Honey? Is she as sweet or as her name implies or is she bitter.

Titles.jpn: 決勝! 父ちゃんは帝王!?

Summaries.eng: With the world championships now underway, the Gulasic group has made their intensions known. What of Fubuki’s suspicious, is Mr. Mystery her father or his he just another player in the game?

Titles.eng: Final Stage: A Reunion that Transcends Time

Summaries.eng: The leader of the of the Gulasic group has now made his presence known, in attempt to act on his vengeance of on the worlds technology. Will Fubuki and Mr. Mystery be able to beat the Leader in his world of X? Or will they be defeated and worlds gaming networks will fall to the hands of evil.
